steps.step: Arrive, sign in, site induction, set up work area
hazards: Public / occupants entering the work area
Slips, trips and falls on uneven ground
controls: Barricade or tape off the work area; keep occupants and public out
Site-specific: property occupied. Barricade the work area, keep access routes clear and tell the occupier each day what is isolated
Complete principal contractor / client site induction and sign in
Review this SWMS with all workers before starting. Workers sign the sign-on sheet
Check access routes; keep work area tidy and remove trip hazards
Live sewer: plug or divert flows before cutting in; treat all waste as infectious; wash before eating or drinking

hazards: Striking gas, electrical, water, sewer or telecommunications services
controls: Obtain Before You Dig Australia plans; keep them on site
Mark out services; pothole by hand or vacuum excavation near them
Stop work and notify the asset owner if an unidentified service is found

steps.step: Identify asbestos before disturbing building materials (pre-2004 buildings)
hazards: Inhaling asbestos fibres from AC pipe, flues, sheeting, vinyl, mastics
controls: Avoid disturbing suspect material; reroute pipework where possible
Site-specific: suspect asbestos material is left undisturbed; pipework and fixings routed around it
Check the asbestos register, ask the owner, or presume asbestos is present
Stop work if suspect material is found unexpectedly; isolate the area and get it tested

steps.step: Set up traffic control and plant exclusion zones
hazards: Workers struck by vehicles or mobile plant
controls: Physical barriers separating workers from traffic and plant
Plant fitted with reversing alarms and beacons
Traffic guidance scheme implemented by accredited traffic controllers where required
Plant exclusion zones; spotter for reversing; eye contact with the operator before approaching

steps.step: Mark out pipe route and set levels
hazards: Working near the public or occupants

controls: Use trenchless methods (e.g. pipe bursting, directional boring) where practicable
Barricade or cover the excavation when unattended
Support the trench with shoring or a trench shield, or bench or batter the sides to a safe angle, before anyone enters
Keep spoil, materials and plant at least 1 m back from the edge (more for deep trenches or poor ground)
Site-specific: trench shield or shoring installed before entry, and workers stay inside the protected zone
Exclusion zone around the operating excavator; spotter when workers are nearby
Safe access and egress (ladder) within the supported area
Competent person inspects the excavation daily and after rain

steps.step: Lay, joint and test pipework in the trench
controls: Work only within the supported section
No one in the trench during backfill or while plant moves nearby
Follow test procedure; clear the area during pressure testing

steps.step: Work on small quantities of non-friable asbestos (no more than 10 m2), if unavoidable
hazards: Fibre release when cutting or breaking
controls: No power tools, abrasives or high-pressure water on asbestos
Barricade the area with signage; keep others out
Wet the material; use hand tools; shadow vacuum with an H-class vacuum
Wrap waste in heavy-duty plastic, label it, and dispose of it at a licensed facility
Decontaminate tools and the area before leaving

steps.step: Connect to the existing system / make the junction (live sewer)
controls: Plug or divert flows before cutting in
Hand washing; cover cuts; keep up to date with recommended vaccinations (e.g. hepatitis A)
Gloves and eye protection; change contaminated clothing
No one in the trench during backfill; exclusion zone around plant
Limit time on vibrating plate; rotate operators

steps.step: Handle pipes, fittings, tools and materials
hazards: Strain or sprain from lifting, carrying or awkward postures
controls: Use trolleys, pipe racks and mechanical aids for heavy or long items
Team lift items over about 20 kg or awkward loads. Plan the route first
Rotate tasks for sustained kneeling or overhead work
Gloves; knee pads for kneeling work

steps.step: Use power and hand tools (cutting, drilling, threading)
controls: Use battery tools where practicable; guards fitted and working
Portable RCD on all plug-in equipment
Tools and leads tested and tagged (3-monthly on construction sites, AS/NZS 3012). Visual check before use
Safety glasses; hearing protection when noise is high (e.g. cutting, core drilling)

steps.step: Use hazardous chemicals (solvent cement and primer, sealants, drain cleaners, LPG)
controls: Use in ventilated areas; keep containers closed
Current SDS available on site. Follow SDS handling and first aid instructions
No ignition sources near flammable products
Chemical-resistant gloves and eye protection as per SDS

hazards: Unsecured openings or excavations left behind
controls: Remove waste; dispose of offcuts and chemical containers correctly
Leave no open excavation, pit or roof penetration unprotected
Report incidents and near misses to the supervisor the same day

flags.text: [Job assessment] Own crew operating earthmoving plant: confirm the operator's competency (ticket or verification of competency).
Alex Sample: Crystalline silica exposure prevention - 10830NAT (ACT mandatory): missing.
Earthmoving plant listed: confirm the operator's competency (VOC or ticket) and that the plant pre-start check is done.
[Excavation and trenching] Confirm Before You Dig Australia plans have been obtained and services located (potholing near services).
[Excavation and trenching] Confirm the trench support method (shoring, benching or battering) suits the ground conditions. Get geotechnical advice if unsure.
[Possible asbestos] Confirm the asbestos register (commercial) has been sighted, or the presence of asbestos has been assumed and recorded (r 422-425).

[Possible asbestos] Friable asbestos, or more than 10 m2 of non-friable asbestos, must be removed by a licensed asbestos removalist. Check the quantity and type. If over the threshold, this SWMS does NOT authorise the removal.
[Possible asbestos] ACT: check the affected residential premises (loose-fill) register for the address.
[Possible asbestos] ACT: the rules for asbestos work without a removal licence are stricter than the 10 m2 model threshold. Confirm what this worker may do (pending legal review).
[Traffic and mobile plant] Work on or next to a road needs a traffic guidance scheme or traffic management plan from the road authority's accredited provider. Confirm who supplies it.
